scope: Keep retained JTL ship-component reverse engineering while making its authored component-level curve and PRE-CU Shipwright reverse modifiers authoritative, without the later NGE trader expertise bonus.

eraEvidence.basis: Jump to Lightspeed ship-component reverse engineering is retained content, but the post-NGE expertise tree is not part of the Publish 14.1 profession model. The retained tool already gates each component family with the four Shipwright reverse modifiers and defines its complete one-through-ten output curve locally.
findings: The generic and armor analysis-tool object templates both attach space.crafting.analysis_tool, making this a reachable player crafting path.
The analysis tool requires a component set whose count equals its reverse-engineering level and whose members share component type and level.
Eight component-family output methods use engineering_reverse, propulsion_reverse, systems_reverse, or defense_reverse from the retained Shipwright skill tree.
The authored level curve grants one through six percent for levels one through ten; the removed code added a separate post-NGE expertise_reverse_engineering_bonus on top of every result.
Charges, reverse-engineered output flags, source-component consumption, legendary loot, and Firespray schematic handling are independent retained behaviors.
